tafsir_check.al_jalalayn_20:121: Preserves the singular: 'wa 'asa Aadamu rabbahu fa-ghawa bil-akli min al-shajara' — Adam (singular) disobeyed his Lord by eating. Proposal's paraphrase is faithful.
tafsir_check.al_tabari_7:23: 'wa-'tirafihima 'ala anfusihima bil-dhanb ... khilaf jawab al-la'in Iblis iyyah' — their confession against themselves = the OPPOSITE of the cursed Iblis's answer. Anchor verified verbatim.
tafsir_check.CAVEAT: al-Tabari on 20:121 paraphrases the disobedience in the DUAL: 'khalafa amra rabbihima' (both contravened their Lord). al-Muyassar keeps it singular ('khalafa Adamu amra rabbihi'). So classical tradition is SPLIT on the singular, and NO classical source draws the inference that the singular deliberately exculpates Eve. That inference is modern. The proposal's 'if anything, lands on Adam' hedge and its flagging of Genesis-divergence as modern are therefore MANDATORY, not optional.
